name: layer-shell-qt-6.7.4 for lxqt
title: layer-shell-qt-6.7.4 for lxqt
summary: This component is meant for applications to be able to easily use clients based on a "wlr-layer-shell" protocol. Clients can use this interface to assign the surface_layer role to wl_surfaces. Such surfaces are assigned to a "layer" of the output and rendered with a defined z-depth respective to each other.
